title: Residential Natural Gas Supply Terms of Service — Renewal of a Term
content:
**1. Acceptance of the offer (retired clause).** The former clause read: a customer renews by accepting the offer in the governing gas renewal notice, and the agreement takes the offered plan, its term in months and the offered renewal rate. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**2. Active agreements only.** A renewal is accepted only on an active agreement, as the agreement's status in the company's records shows.

**3. Start of the new term.** When the election is made on or before the contract end date, the new term starts the day after the contract end date; when it is made after a rollover, the new term starts on the election date.

**4. Grace period after rollover.** When the gas agreement has already rolled over, a renewal election is honoured only when the customer elects to renew no later than the post-expiry renewal grace period — 30 calendar days on every Residential Natural Gas Supply plan — after the rollover took effect on the plan change date. Day one is the calendar day after the plan change date, and the grace period closes at the end of the calendar day equal to the plan change date plus 30 calendar days; that last day is included.

**5. Loyalty credit (retired clause).** The former clause read: each renewal earns one renewal loyalty credit equal to the renewal loyalty credit amount of the plan renewed into, posted on the first bill of the new term, and plans with 0.00 earn none. **This clause is no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis and is not applied.

**6. What is not a renewal.** A late election or a choice of a plan other than the one offered is a plan change, not a renewal.

### Grace period boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

| Rollover took effect (plan change date) | Customer elects to renew on | Day of grace period | Election |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 April | 2 April | day 1 | honoured |
| 1 April | 1 May | day 30, the closing day | honoured |
| 1 April | 2 May | day 31 | not honoured as a renewal (a late election is a plan change) |

### Start of the new term

| Election made | New term starts |
|---|---|
| on or before the contract end date (for example, end date 30 September) | the day after the contract end date (1 October) |
| after a rollover, within the grace period | the election date |

Each renewal earns one renewal_loyalty_credit equal to the renewal_loyalty_credit_usd of the plan renewed into, posted on the first bill of the new term; plans with 0.00 earn none.
